children: Sashi Jagdishan won’t stay for a third term atop the $115 bln lender. He might not have got it anyway: persistent governance woes overshadowed handling a tricky merger and severe business curbs. Hiring its first outsider as CEO would help the bank restore some lost credibility.
Follow Shritama Bose on LinkedIn and X.

HDFC Bank is likely to name Deputy Managing Director Kaizad Bharucha as one of two options for its next CEO after incumbent Sashidhar Jagdishan retires at the end of his second term in October, Reuters reported on August 30, citing two unnamed people familiar with the matter.

The bank on August 29 said Jagdishan had decided not to seek re-appointment to the role. His second three-year term ends on October 26. "The Board decided to fast-track the process for selection and appointment of his successor well within time," HDFC said in a filing.
